dedupe_keys.name: chicago green roofs map and shapefile 2010 satellite survey

description: This dataset maps the existing green roofs of Chicago with their location, satellite image and square footage. A consultant for the City of Chicago derived it from 50 cm pan-sharpened, 8-band WorldView-2 satellite imagery collected mostly in August 2010, with the rest in September and October, over the 2009 city boundary. It found 359 vegetated roofs covering about 5,469,463 square feet, a median of 5,234 square feet each, and a ratio of required to elective roofs of 297 to 62. Coverage is the City of Chicago. Format and access: a web map on the Chicago Data Portal and an ESRI shapefile listed on data.gov, last updated in February 2013. Licence: the portal's terms of use; no licence is named in the metadata; free. Caveats: it is a 2010 snapshot, and small or sparse roofs may be missed by satellite classification. It supports stormwater and urban heat studies of green roofs as green infrastructure. Related catalogue records are the London green roofs survey and the Hamburg Green Roof Strategy case study.
